Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsError(v) Then
        Show = "E:" & CStr(v)
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

8013.note: One digit of Formula on a number a hair past a fifteen-digit tie. See known_differences.

known_differences: Cell.Formula and =A1&"" round a Double very near a fifteen-digit tie in a way not modelled, CStr exactly: 2597210.0129976850003 reads 2597210.01299768 in Formula and 2597210.01299769 in CStr. Of 300 doubles sought out within 0.005 of the sixteenth digit past a tie, 28 went down when exact rounding goes up, with no threshold.
